s-1.ptxt: Install Back Door Damper Stay Bracket Upper LH

s2.ptxt: Clean the threads on the body side with white gasoline.
Install the back door damper stay bracket upper LH with the 2 bolts.
When replacing the back door stay bolt with a new one

s3.ptxt: Clean the threads on the body side with white gasoline.
Install the back door stay bolt.

s2.ptxt: When reusing the back door stay bolt

s3.ptxt: Clean the threads on the body side with white gasoline.
Install the back door stay bolt.

s-1.ptxt: Install Back Door Stay Assembly LH

item.ptxt: When removing and installing, hold the cylinder and avoid touching the rod stroke area as much as possible to prevent foreign matter from adhering.
Do not touch the rod with work gloves or similar, as fibers may adhere and cause gas leakage.
Do not apply a load in the lateral direction of the cylinder, to prevent the rod from deforming.
Hold the joint when checking the installation condition.

s2.ptxt: Install the stop ring to the back door stay assembly LH.
Engage the ball joint and install the back door stay assembly LH.

atten3.ptxt: Install the back door stay assembly LH while holding the back door so that it does not lower.

s2.ptxt: Check that the back door stay assembly LH is engaged with the ball joint and does not come off.
